sources.evidence: Downloaded genuine 16-page PDF; pages 10 and 11 rendered and visually inspected. Engine and overall ratios on 10; suspension/brakes on 11. Text extraction partly corrupt; actual table image authoritative.

sources.type: Ford OEM SVT Classroom Course September 2003, third-party archive
sources.evidence: Downloaded genuine PDF; physical pages93–95 (printed 3-45–3-47) rendered and visually inspected. Model-family technical table, not individual VIN certification or explicit option-weight table.

engine.layout: Naturally aspirated gasoline transverse front inline four-cylinder DOHC 16-valve, variable intake cam timing, dual-stage intake
engine.redlineNote: Training labels redline, not independently established fuel-cut rpm
engine.fuel: 91 octane recommended in US owner supplement

runtimeRepresentation.label: Effective scaled representation of rounded OEM overall reductions; final 4 is arbitrary scaling, NOT physical Ford differential ratio. Necessary because editor gear clamp 5.5 would lose first with final 1. Verify actual editor roundtrip and overall products before import.

drivetrain.rounding: Do not claim exact tooth counts or reconcile rounded physical products as exact. Use consistent rounded owner overall values; archive racing classification has different more precise values not substituted.

chassis.massConvention: Manufacturer classroom table says curb weight only. Driver/fuel convention and optional-equipment inclusion not defined. Do not silently add fuel twice; this is not a measured specific-car weight. Table does not separately label three/five-door, so retain model-family provenance caveat. Contemporary 2003 three-door roadtest independently corroborates 2750 lb.
chassis.brakeConstruction: Front vented, rear solid; single piston both ends; four-channel ABS

conflicts: Owner page 11 publishes front 22 N/mm and rear 27.5 N/mm spring rates,21 mm anti-roll bars. Racing classification search index calls 2003 front bar 22 mm. Do not treat bar or spring constants as production-confirmed runtime handling without motion-ratio and variant evidence.
Secondary databases return conflicting 2551/2593/2675 lb, likely mixed trims; use OEM model-family 2750 lb with disclosed convention caveat.
Owner compression printed 10:2:1 typography; training clearly 10.2:1.
No single physical final drive applies to every gear.
unknowns: Exact fuel cutoff and idle speed
Differential type not independently verified from inspected tables
Damper curves, suspension motion ratios, tire friction and load sensitivity
